# Ricardo Camilo — Senior Frontend Developer Portfolio

> Portfolio of Ricardo Camilo, a Senior Frontend Developer with 6+ years of experience specializing in Vue.js, TypeScript, React, and modern frontend architecture.

Ricardo builds performant, accessible, and scalable web applications. Expert in Vue 3, Nuxt, Next.js, React, and TypeScript. Strong background in PWA development, performance optimization, and component-driven architecture. Based in Brazil, working remotely for international clients.
